settings.intro: Changes apply to jobs started after saving; jobs already in progress keep the settings they started with. Every change is recorded in the change history.
settings.resetHint: Every settings tab now shows the default values. Save to apply them.
settings.invalid: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
settings.reviewThresholdsIntro: Segments crossing any of these thresholds are kept but marked "Review" in the transcript, to be checked against the audio.

whisper_model_name.label: Whisper model
whisper_model_name.help: large-v3 is the most accurate; turbo is several times faster. A model is downloaded the first time it is used.

diarization_model.label: Diarization model
diarization_model.help: Separates the speakers. 3.1 is lighter; community-1 is more accurate but needs much more memory (~12 GB VRAM recommended). Applies from the next audio, without a restart. Both require accepting the model's conditions on Hugging Face with the HF_TOKEN account; each is downloaded on first use.

beam_size.label: Beam size
beam_size.help: 1 = greedy decoding (fastest). Higher values explore more hypotheses: more accurate but slower. Recommended: 5.

temperature_fallback.label: Temperature fallback
temperature_fallback.help: Retries a segment with more randomness when the first decode looks degenerate (repetitions, very low confidence).

vad_filter.label: Voice activity detection (VAD)
vad_filter.help: Skips silence and noise before transcribing — the main defence against hallucinated text.

vad_onset.label: VAD speech threshold
vad_onset.help: Probability above which audio counts as speech. Lower keeps quiet speech (e.g. phone calls) but lets in more noise.

vad_offset.label: VAD silence threshold
vad_offset.help: Probability below which speech is considered finished. Must be lower than the speech threshold.

vad_min_silence_ms.label: Minimum silence (ms)
vad_min_silence_ms.help: How long a pause must last to split speech. Shorter pauses split turn-taking in calls.

vad_speech_pad_ms.label: Speech padding (ms)
vad_speech_pad_ms.help: Extra audio kept around each speech chunk so the edges of words aren't cut.

hallucination_silence_enabled.label: Skip silences where the model starts hallucinating

hallucination_silence_threshold.label: Silence to skip (seconds)
hallucination_silence_threshold.help: When the model shows signs of hallucinating, silent stretches longer than this are skipped. Requires word-level timestamps (slightly slower).

low_confidence_avg_logprob.label: Review below average log-probability
low_confidence_avg_logprob.help: How sure the model was about the words. Lower (more negative) = less sure.

low_confidence_no_speech_prob.label: Review above no-speech probability
low_confidence_no_speech_prob.help: How likely the model thought the segment was silence or noise.

low_confidence_compression_ratio.label: Review above compression ratio
low_confidence_compression_ratio.help: High values mean repetitive text, a typical hallucination symptom.

hallucination_phrases.label: Phrases removed as hallucinations
hallucination_phrases.help: One per line. Removed only when they make up an entire segment; case, accents and punctuation are ignored. Amara.org credits and subtitle credit lines are always removed.

audio_highpass.label: High-pass filter (80 Hz)
audio_highpass.help: Removes mains hum and low rumble below the speech band.

audio_loudnorm.label: Loudness normalization
audio_loudnorm.help: Brings quiet recordings up to a consistent speech level, so quiet calls aren't mistaken for silence.

default_language.label: Default transcription language
default_language.help: Preselected on the upload screen. "Auto-detect" lets the model identify the language.

help.llm: Translates with the configured language model (LLM_API_URL), following European Portuguese. Needs the LLM server and is the slowest.
help.nllb: Translates on this server with Meta's NLLB-200, without the LLM: faster and lighter, for about 200 languages. The first translation downloads Meta's model (about 2.5 GB) and converts it to about 600 MB, which takes a few minutes and about 5 GB of memory. Its Portuguese is generic (it may follow Brazilian usage). License CC-BY-NC 4.0: non-commercial use only.

job_retention_hours.label: Retention (hours)
job_retention_hours.help: Audios uploaded on their own, and their files, are deleted automatically after this many hours. Does not apply to projects.

project_retention_days.label: Project retention (days)
project_retention_days.help: Projects and all their files are deleted automatically after this many days. Applies to projects created from now on; a project's expiry date never changes once it is created.

llm_summary_system_prompt.label: Summary: system instructions
llm_summary_system_prompt.help: Tells the model its role and the rules of the summary (sent as the system message).

llm_summary_request.label: Summary: request
llm_summary_request.help: Placed right before the transcript in the request.

llm_translation_instructions.label: Translation: instructions
llm_translation_instructions.help: What the model must do with each segment. The JSON answer format below is added automatically.

llm_language_rule.label: Language rule
llm_language_rule.help: Added to the end of the system message of every summary and translation.

llm_language_reminder.label: Final reminder
llm_language_reminder.help: Placed after the transcript: small models weigh the end of the request most.

max_upload_mb.label: Maximum size per file (MB)
max_upload_mb.help: Applies from now on to uploaded audios, recordings made in the browser and project audios. At most 500 MB: that is nginx's limit, and each file is held in memory while it is received.

default_daily_tokens.label: Default daily tokens
default_daily_tokens.help: The daily quota of users without their own (set under Users). It is full again every day at midnight and does not accumulate; uploads use this quota first and the extra balance after it. 0 = no daily quota.

restartOnly.hint: These change only in the backend environment (.env), followed by a restart.

errors.offsetBelowOnset: Must be lower than the speech threshold.
errors.phraseTooLong: Each phrase can have at most {{max}} characters.

prompts.intro: Changes apply to the next summary or translation, with no restart. Leave a field empty, or use "Reset to default", to use the built-in text. Each change, with the old and new text, is recorded in the history.
prompts.summaryAssembly: Sent as: system = system instructions + language rule; request = request + transcript + final reminder.
prompts.translationAssembly: Sent as: system = instructions + JSON answer format (fixed) + language rule; request = the numbered segments as JSON.
prompts.languageIntro: Keeps every answer in European Portuguese.
prompts.fixedIntro: The application depends on these, so they cannot be edited.

translation_output_contract.label: Translation answer format
translation_output_contract.help: Each translated line is matched back to its segment by the "i" index, so the answer must keep this exact JSON shape.

qwen3_no_think.label: Qwen3 thinking switch
qwen3_no_think.help: Appended to every request for Qwen3 models. Without it, a small Qwen3 can spend its whole output limit "thinking" and return an empty answer.

auth.tokensDailyHint: Tokens you still have today (the daily quota is full again at midnight and does not accumulate) and the extra balance, used once the quota runs out. Each transcription uses 1 token; if processing fails, the token is given back.
auth.tokensDailyOnlyHint: Tokens you still have today (the daily quota is full again at midnight and does not accumulate). Each transcription uses 1 token; if processing fails, the token is given back.
auth.tokensUnlimitedHint: Unlimited tokens: transcriptions do not use tokens.

errors.internal: An unexpected error occurred on the server.
